objective: Start the exact, state-safe VLM and SAM prefetch after a blank frame remains visible, so operator inspection time can cover cold model work instead of waiting until the auto-draft dialog opens.

cold_bottleneck_profile.interpretation: Cold latency is dominated by VLM generation; image preprocessing, upload, state save, and SAM are not the primary first-result bottleneck.

change.trigger: labelagent:frame-state after the current frame and its compact annotation state are loaded
change.rapid_navigation_behavior: A newer frame event cancels the prior timer and invalidates any stale completion.
skip_conditions: current frame already has human truth
current frame already has machine candidates
the operator explicitly selected a single-label mode
file path, topic, labels, or current-frame binding is missing
SAM or VLM readiness is false
change.server_safety: The existing prefetch endpoint still refuses active workflows and busy unrelated model work. Prefetch does not save candidates, human truth, references, or training approval.
change.exact_request_reuse: Opening the dialog or clicking during the same in-flight request reuses or coalesces the existing exact discovery request.

integration_issue_found_and_fixed.first_attempt: The lightweight frame-state event did not include an explicit loaded=true field, so the speculative prefetch was safely skipped and no model request was made.
integration_issue_found_and_fixed.fix: Treat a non-empty bound path plus topic as loaded for the lightweight event while retaining all exact path, topic, frame, and label bindings.
